meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞／曲：趙治德

lines.b: I offer up a heart of worship

lines.a: 每個呼吸每個決定都為了祢
lines.b: Every breath, every decision is for You
Till the day You come again
No matter the price I have to pay
You say that worship cannot be false

lines.a: 只要祭物是來自我心靈 主祢就悅納
lines.b: If the sacrifice is from my spirit, You will accept it
No matter the price I have to pay
When I say "I love You" once again
I will say it from the depths of my heart

lines.a: 心與心 心與心 深淵與深淵響應
lines.b: Heart-to-heart, deep cries out to deep

lines.a: 被火煉 被潔淨 按祢所是的敬拜祢
lines.b: Refined, cleansed, I worship You for who You are
